items.title: Bocaina de Minas (MG) IT procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Dec 2 #06
items.en_title: Bocaina de Minas (MG) IT procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Dec 2 #06
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Bocaina de Minas (MG) is procuring IT equipment, systems or services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 4,585; proposals close Dec 2, 23:59 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
